name: Astrid Karlsson
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport was unconventional, starting not on the track, but in the meticulous world of precision engineering. After graduating top of her class from KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, she spent several years honing her skills in the aerospace industry, working on critical components for aircraft. The rigorous demands and zero-tolerance for error ingrained in her a commitment to quality that few can match.

Her transition to motorsport was driven by a lifelong passion for racing and a desire to apply her expertise in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. At Elite Motorsport, Astrid oversees every stage of component manufacturing and assembly, ensuring that the team's cars meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. Astrid's colleagues know her for her relentless pursuit of perfection and her ability to identify and resolve even the most subtle flaws, making her an invaluable asset to the team.

Astrid's distinctive approach lies in her blend of meticulous analysis and innovative problem-solving. She's not just looking for errors; she's actively seeking ways to improve processes, enhance performance, and push the boundaries of what's possible. Her dedication ensures Elite Motorsport consistently delivers top-tier results.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail during work.
physical.description: Astrid is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulous notes and diagrams.
Insists on using specific tools and equipment, believing they provide superior precision.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against surfaces when deep in thought.
